title: Bohachi Bushido: Code of the Forgotten Eight
writer: San Kaji, Kazuo Koike, Goseki Kojima
actors: Tetsurô Tanba, Gorô Ibuki, Tatsuo Endô
plot: A ronin Shino Asu (I die Tomorrow) gets rescued by the Bohachi clan. Their leader Shirobei Daimon, charged by the Shogun with running Edo's brothels enlists him to kill clients of tea-house whores who are stealing his business.
